title: Minimum Moves to Reach Target Score
description: Find the minimum moves to reach target from 1 using increment and doubling (maxDoubles limit).
pseudocode:
1. moves = 0
2. while target > 1 and maxDoubles > 0:
3.   if target is even: target /= 2, maxDoubles -= 1
4.   else: target -= 1
5.   moves += 1
6. return moves + (target - 1)
